disputed_instances.excerpt: Current draft remains within our red lines: S2’s 7% cap is above Hearth 10’s 6.2% result, and S3’s six-year retrofit deadline meets NW-2. Preserve aggregated-only public reporting; model-specific results to regulators and affected customers are permissible. For S5, do not conflate Northwind’s 8.6 company-wide incident rate with Hearth 10’s 6.4 model rate. The draft’s regulator-confirmed risk/corrective-action condition avoids automatic recall at the threshold.
disputed_instances.comparison: Accepts S2 permanent 7% limit (above acceptable 5%, benefits Northwind) and S5 conditional recall (not mandatory at 8, benefits Halcyon).
